scope: Current finding, waiver and approval lookups; exact waiver failure priority; supplied waiver authorization; blocker resolution; preservation of invalid-waiver diagnostics through acceptance evaluation.
review_procedure: Read all new lookup, waiver, supplied, blocker and diagnostic helpers, input-defined authority predicates, evaluator integration and regression scenarios.
Checked constructor-derived identity uniqueness and the exact-view bridge proofs; prior constructor behavior was independently reviewed in its separate retained checkpoint.
Compared input predicates with actual complete identity, revision, authority and evidence checks; checked resolved-finding freshness from constructor invariants.
Reviewed final strict Verus and Clippy results; independently reran all-target/all-feature quality-policy and kernel tests.
Verified every source-manifest hash before retaining this checkpoint.

commands.implementation_verus: cargo verus verify --package peritus-quality-policy --package peritus-kernel --all-features --locked --check-toolchain --fwd-verus-args-to roots -- --no-cheating --rlimit 20

limits: This manifest binds the fourteen reviewed increment files, not all dependency/compiler inputs or a clean candidate commit.
Canonical constructor and earlier evaluator changes in the same files have separate review history.
The phase Boolean exactly equals supplied-current-waiver validity and current blocker resolution. Top-level acceptance is only proved to imply these conditions.

Invalid supplied current waivers are proved to have matching complete finding IDs in final diagnostics. Exact waiver_failure priority is proved separately; total diagnostic order, multiplicity and absence of false positives are not claimed as a theorem.
Supplied observations, actor identities, evidence digests and authority references are not authenticated by these proofs.
Full final/unexpected approval semantics and kernel lifecycle correspondence remain further implementation work.
No obligation discharge, proof-impact approval, exclusion or GitHub merge restriction is created by this checkpoint; changed source needs renewed review.
